title: Haciendas
tagline: A decentralised game and interface to discover and interact with smart contracts
description: This game is a fun way to interact with smart contract and get acquainted with digital assets. It follows a progression with various quests, from purely actions oriented to interact and send transactions to interact with various smart contracts. With a multiplayer this could move from a learning tool to a lightweight digital place.
how_its_made:
First, it is a pure browser game build on top of Phaser 3, interfaced using the library ethers with the Ethereum blockchain. 



It relies on Portis to provide the user with a wallet and its connection with the Gas Station Network to onboard the user. Then the first interactions are using Tellor for the simple decentralised exchange and to buy a coffee.
